source_edition: Dead Last, publisher English Rules 2.0 (2016), complete base game for 6–12 players

review_scope.visual_review_method: Supplied page-01.png through page-08.png renders of the authoritative PDF; voting page 5, both voting examples, and every payoff panel on page 8 inspected.

verdict_scope: Accuracy and completeness against rules actually specified in the authoritative booklet. This PASS does not certify that every legal game state has an executable official resolution.
summary_assessment: No material contradiction, unsupported replacement rule, or omission of an important source-specified procedure found. The full payoff matrix, final-vote consolation eligibility, Ambush timing and retaliation restriction, central versus deck rewards, thresholds, and repeated score ties are accurately represented.

checked_claims.claim: All component quantities, denominations, colored Voting sets and own-color Ambush
checked_claims.result: supported; visually checked component illustrations and printed counts

checked_claims.claim: Visible ID in a stand, remove unused colors, matching Voting set, four hidden central bars and Showdown sets aside
Conspire before every vote, approximately 90 seconds maximum, any overt/covert communication, owner requests decisions
No individual turn order; one facedown Voting card per survivor, change choices until simultaneous reveal
Highest vote recipient is Target; all highest-vote ties are Targets; non-Target voters also eliminated unless protected by successful Ambush
checked_claims.result: supported for votes with at least one counted target card; source has a separate zero-vote ambiguity

checked_claims.claim: Knock down eliminated IDs; only surviving players continue voting
Exclude Ambush from tally; successful only as Target; survive and eliminate one player who voted for ambusher; failed Ambush eliminates its player
checked_claims.result: supported; retaliation is restricted to actual voters for that ambusher

checked_claims.claim: Red/Yellow/Pink three-player example leaves Red and Pink, with Red allowed to retaliate only against Yellow
checked_claims.result: supported by full visual diagram and caption

checked_claims.claim: Three or more survivors continue; one survivor gets four central bars; two use Final Showdown
Zero survivors rewards only players absent from final vote, each one bar from deck; central four remain and no new central bars added
checked_claims.result: supported by revised printed rule, distinct from double-Steal recipients

checked_claims.claim: Showdown discussion then secret choice from three cards and simultaneous reveal
Full Showdown matrix: Share/Share 2:2; Share/Steal 0:4; Share/Grab 3:1; Steal/Share 4:0; Steal/Steal 0:0; Steal/Grab 3:1; Grab/Share 1:3; Grab/Steal 1:3; Grab/Grab 1:1
checked_claims.result: all nine ordered pairings supported by all six visually inspected source payoff panels

checked_claims.claim: Double Steal keeps four central bars and awards one deck bar to every nonfinalist; double Grab leaves two and adds two; other pairings exhaust central pot
checked_claims.result: supported; component destinations and refill quantities checked

checked_claims.claim: Gold rewards mean cards with variable 3–5 point values, not fixed points
After every round outcome check recipients’ cumulative totals: 25 for 6–9 players, 24 for 10–12; greatest qualifying total wins
Highest qualifying ties require repeated Showdowns until one player anywhere at table has highest total
checked_claims.result: supported; multiway procedure remains unspecified by source

checked_claims.claim: All players return with upright IDs for a new round and leftover central gold remains as prescribed
No important source-specified action cost or payment omitted
checked_claims.result: supported; the source specifies card choices and reward destinations, without an additional resource cost

essential_source_executability.assessment: Ordinary positive-vote rounds and the six Showdown pairings are executable. The booklet does not provide a complete official resolution for all legal states: a three-or-more-way qualifying-score tie definitely lacks a procedure. All-Ambush zero-count voting is also ambiguous; extra tiebreak pot preparation is implicit.

unresolved_source_limitations.case: Three or more players tie for the highest qualifying gold total at the end of a round.
unresolved_source_limitations.source_evidence: Page 4 sends the tied players to another Final Showdown. Page 3 supplies only two Showdown sets, and pages 7–8 describe only two players and pairwise payoffs.
unresolved_source_limitations.missing_ruling: No participant selection, grouping, sequencing, or multiway payoff procedure is supplied.
unresolved_source_limitations.summary_handling: Explicitly disclosed in the scoring section; correctly declines to invent an official procedure.

unresolved_source_limitations.case: Every surviving player chooses Ambush, so there are no counted votes.
unresolved_source_limitations.source_evidence: Page 6 says Ambush cards are not counted, defines successful Ambush by receiving enough votes to be a Target, and requires a successful ambusher to eliminate someone who voted for them. Page 5 says highest votes, including tied Targets, without a zero-vote qualification.
unresolved_source_limitations.missing_ruling: The source never says whether zero counted votes yields no Targets or all zero-vote players tied as Targets, nor how to perform retaliation when nobody voted for an ambusher. Those readings produce different eliminations.
unresolved_source_limitations.summary_handling: Repeats the source’s general rules without inventing a zero-vote ruling; it does not identify this separate source ambiguity.
unresolved_source_limitations.classification: Ambiguity already present in authoritative source; do not grade an invented ruling as a summary requirement.

unresolved_source_limitations.case: A winning-score tie requires an additional Showdown after the round has already distributed some or all central bars.
unresolved_source_limitations.source_evidence: Page 4 calls for another Showdown; pages 7–8 prescribe four-bar pairwise payoffs, but only ordinary next-round replenishment and the double-Grab/double-Steal carryovers are described.
unresolved_source_limitations.missing_ruling: A special tiebreak pot preparation step is not explicitly written. Refilling to four before an extra Showdown is a natural operational inference, not an expressly stated separate tiebreak instruction.
unresolved_source_limitations.summary_handling: Does not assert a new official tiebreak pot rule.
unresolved_source_limitations.classification: Secondary source underspecification; weaker than the definite missing multiway procedure.

snapshot_specific_observation: Setup explicitly places each ID upright in its plastic stand and starts all IDs standing. This clarification is supported by page 3 and the elimination/reset instructions on pages 5 and 8.
